coverage_note: Credible subset only: consumer electronics + one cosmetics contrast SKU; EU, US, Indonesia. Every requirement binds an official or platform source URL. This is not global coverage.

requirements.title: Radio equipment must meet RED essential requirements and conformity assessment
requirements.missing_if_unmet: RED conformity assessment / CE under RED / RF test report
actions: Obtain RF/EMC test report covering the wireless module against RED essential requirements
Complete EU Declaration of Conformity naming Directive 2014/53/EU
Affix CE marking and retain technical documentation

evidence.excerpt: Radio equipment shall be constructed so as to ensure the protection of health and safety, EMC, and effective use of radio spectrum. Manufacturers shall ensure that radio equipment has been designed and manufactured in accordance with the essential requirements and shall draw up the EU declaration of conformity.

requirements.title: Mains-powered electrical equipment must meet LVD safety objectives
requirements.missing_if_unmet: LVD safety test / CE under LVD
actions: Test against applicable LVD harmonised standards
Prepare technical file and EU Declaration of Conformity

evidence.excerpt: Electrical equipment may be made available on the market only if it has been designed and manufactured in accordance with the safety objectives set out in Annex I.

requirements.title: Electrical equipment must meet EMC essential requirements
requirements.missing_if_unmet: EMC test report / CE under EMC
actions: Obtain EMC test report against applicable harmonised standards

evidence.excerpt: Equipment shall be so designed and manufactured as to ensure that the electromagnetic disturbance generated does not exceed the level above which radio and telecommunications equipment cannot operate as intended.

requirements.title: Non-EU manufacturers need an economic operator established in the EU as responsible person
requirements.missing_if_unmet: EU responsible person / authorised representative named on product or packaging
actions: Appoint an EU responsible person
Place name and contact details on the product or packaging
Ensure technical documentation can be provided to market surveillance

evidence.excerpt: A product may be placed on the market only if there is an economic operator established in the Union responsible for the tasks in Article 4(3). For products from outside the Union this is typically the importer or an authorised representative.

requirements.title: Cosmetic products must be notified in CPNP before being placed on the EU market
requirements.missing_if_unmet: CPNP notification and Product Information File
actions: Appoint an EU responsible person under Article 4
Compile the Product Information File
Submit CPNP notification before placing on the market
Ensure labelling meets Article 19

evidence.excerpt: Only cosmetic products for which a legal or natural person is designated within the Community as responsible person shall be placed on the market. The responsible person shall submit specified information through the Cosmetic Products Notification Portal before placing the product on the market.

requirements.title: Intentional radiators (Bluetooth/Wi-Fi) require FCC equipment authorization
actions: Complete FCC equipment authorization for the radio module or host
Label the product with FCC ID or SDoC statement as applicable
Retain test reports for Part 15

evidence.excerpt: Intentional radiators must be authorized under the certification or Supplier's Declaration of Conformity procedures as specified. Operation in the 2400-2483.5 MHz band is subject to §15.247 technical limits.

regulations.document: Consumer Product Safety Act / general consumer product safety obligations

requirements.title: Consumer products must not present an unreasonable risk of injury; CPSC can recall
requirements.missing_if_unmet: Safety assessment / test report retained for CPSC/Amazon requests
actions: Retain safety test evidence from an accredited lab
Monitor CPSC recalls for the product category

evidence.excerpt: Manufacturers, importers, distributors and retailers must report potentially hazardous products and may be required to recall products that present a substantial product hazard.

regulations.document: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act; Modernization of Cosmetics Regulation Act (MoCRA)

requirements.title: Cosmetic facility registration, product listing, and labeling obligations under MoCRA
requirements.missing_if_unmet: FDA facility registration, product listing, and compliant English labeling
actions: Register the facility and list the product with FDA as required by MoCRA
Ensure ingredient labeling and responsible person US contact
Do not make drug claims unless the product is also an OTC drug

evidence.article: Facility registration and product listing provisions
evidence.excerpt: MoCRA requires facility registration and product listing for cosmetics marketed in the United States, and expands FDA's authority over adverse event reporting and records.

requirements.title: Cosmetics may not be circulated in Indonesia without BPOM notification number (NIE)
requirements.missing_if_unmet: BPOM Notifkos notification number (NIE) held by a local Indonesian entity
actions: Appoint a local Indonesian license holder (PT PMA or partner)
Compile PIF / DIP and formula against BPOM ingredient annexes
Submit notification via notifkos.pom.go.id
Put NIE and required Indonesian label text on packaging

evidence.document: Notifkos cosmetic notification portal / BPOM cosmetic circulation control
evidence.excerpt: Cosmetic notification is processed through the official Notifkos system. A notification number is the legal evidence that the cosmetic product has been reviewed for circulation in Indonesia. Imported cosmetics require a local business entity.

regulations.authority: Direktorat Jenderal Sumber Daya dan Perangkat Pos dan Informatika (DJID/SDPPI)
regulations.document: Certification of telecommunication tools and devices before import/distribution

requirements.title: Wireless/telecom devices require DJID/SDPPI certification before Indonesian distribution
actions: Test the radio device at a designated lab
Apply for DJID/SDPPI certification via sertifikasi.postel.go.id
Affix the certification mark before import

evidence.excerpt: Telecommunication tools and devices must obtain certification from the Indonesian authority (DJID/SDPPI) through the official certification portal before they can be legally distributed.

regulations.document: SNI IEC 60598-1 Luminaires – Part 1: General requirements and tests (mandatory SNI scope for certain lamps/luminaires)

requirements.title: Certain lamps and luminaires circulating in Indonesia require SNI conformity
actions: Confirm whether this exact lamp type is in the current mandatory SNI list
If in scope, obtain SNI certification via an LSPro
Expert review recommended because mandatory SNI lists change by Kemenperin decree

evidence.document: SNI IEC 60598-1 and related mandatory SNI decrees for lighting
evidence.excerpt: Indonesia applies SNI standards, including IEC-based luminaire standards, to specified lighting products. Whether a given SKU is in the mandatory list depends on the current Ministry of Industry decree; absence of SNI is treated as WARNING plus expert review rather than a silent PASS.

regulations.document: Indexed 2026 monitoring event: luminaire SNI/IEC 60598 conformity evidence now required (demo change object)

requirements.title: Lighting SKUs must evidence SNI/IEC 60598 after the monitored update
actions: Re-test or update SNI certificate to the monitored standard version
Do not ship additional lots until the certificate is current

evidence.excerpt: This record represents a versioned monitoring event against the SNI/IEC 60598 luminaire family. It is used to re-evaluate lighting SKUs. Existing SNI tokens that do not match the new version token are treated as stale.
